mathematical_meanings: Left image: O names the origin of the coordinate axes (the label at the crossing of the axes beside the parabola). Right image: O names the origin of the coordinate axes (the label where the x and h axes meet).
Rationales: In both images, O names the origin of the coordinate axes. The relevant locations are the label at the crossing of the axes beside the parabola on the left and the label where the x and h axes meet on the right.
